headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang now faces a formal congressional investigation over alleged ties to a Chinese spy, as reports found the US let Nvidia sell advanced chips to an empty office in China and researchers grew alarmed at Anthropic's accelerating AI R&D automation.

points.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces increasing congressional scrutiny, with lawmakers saying Congress will investigate after reports he had a romantic relationship with a purported Chinese spy.
The New York Times reported concerns that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia did proper due diligence before the US let Nvidia sell advanced H200 AI chips to an empty office in China.
SemiAnalysis visited a wind-powered 800MW data center campus in Inner Mongolia, part of what it called China's 'Stargate.'
Cognition's chief security officer Alex Stamos discussed how AI has upended cybersecurity and what comes next, in the first part of a Verge series on AI and security.
Researchers grew alarmed at a report showing Anthropic is using AI to automate its own AI development, with its models improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago and little sign of slowing.

geo: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang now faces a formal congressional investigation.
